reviews.title: Non-responsive
reviews.text: I was really excited about this app and signed up for a one week free trial. After signing up for the free trial, the app never recognized my subscription. I emailed the company asking for assistance and never got a reply (I did check for a response in my spam folder but nothing was there). Based on this, I emailed the company asking to cancel the trial and subscription; again I did not get a reply. After receiving a bill for $297, I yet again contacted the company asking for a refund and again did not get a reply. I had to contact my credit card company and mark the charge as fraudulent. 0 for 3 in their support team replying… Be cautious in signing up—they will take your money and make it so you can never cancel your subscription. Looking at the other one star reviews, this does not appear to be an isolated issue! No need to reply asking me to email your help email address like you have in the other one star reviews- you had three shots at this and struck out!

reviews.title: Amazing app!!!
reviews.text:
I’ve struggled with falling asleep and waking up when I need to for as long as I can remember, going all the way back to my teenage years. I was 38 years old when I found Sleep Reset, and it has honestly been life-changing.

When I actually follow the program and do the things the app teaches, it works. I’m able to fall asleep when I want to, wake up when I need to, and I have so much more energy throughout the day.

After dealing with sleep problems for so many years, finding something that actually helps has made a huge difference in my life. Sleep Reset is an absolute masterpiece. I highly recommend it to anyone who has struggled with sleep.

reviews.title: Not a real app
reviews.text: The whole interview is just a way to get you to meet with a clinician.

reviews.title: Too expensive and pricing not clear
reviews.text: I was led to believe that the fee was based on a course that I would pay regardless of how quickly I moved through these sections.  It charges you based on time periods whether you are able to login or not.  I am really disappointed in the product and service.  If you need help with insomnia, this is not the product or service to use.  I feel taken advantage of and ripped off.

reviews.title: Helping!
reviews.text: I’ve struggled with being able to fall asleep for over 20 years as I have the common problem of not being able to shut my mind off. I’ve been using this program for three weeks and have only struggled one time. I am cautiously optimistic that this is going to be a life changer. Only time will tell but so far I am extremely happy with the process.

reviews.title: Didn’t work for me
reviews.text: It looks like the program worked for some people but not for me. My “sleep efficiency” went from 44% to 56% with the goal being 90% and this was after I abandoned some of the techniques because they just didn’t work for me. I can’t really call this a success. I still feel that the $500 I spent for 8 weeks was not a waste because I am pretty desperate to get some sleep so it was worth a try. Also I was given some tools to work on after I left the program. It was nice to have a personal coach who was very good and responded quickly to my questions. Some of the replies appeared to come from prewritten templates but were still useful. So the program might be worth a try if you’re desperate to get some sleep. It just didn’t work for me.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This program completely turned around my insomnia, you may need to give it a full eight weeks, but the coaches and programming are wonderful

reviews.title: The First Sleep Program That Actually Worked
reviews.text: I’ve tried a lot of different things to improve my sleep, and Sleep Reset was the first one that actually worked and stuck. Beyond just sleeping better, I learned a ton about sleep and built habits that feel sustainable long term. The biggest difference was reframing how I thought about sleep - moving away from the anxiety and pressure around it that can create a vicious cycle, and learning to approach it much more positively. It’s made a huge difference for me and I couldn’t recommend Sleep Reset enough.

reviews.title: Insomnia solution
reviews.text: I’ve had insomnia, on and off, since my teens.  The only solution was running.  As I’ve gotten older and hardcore running was no longer an option my insomnia has gotten much worse.  In search of a solution my wife found the Sleep Reset app, which is a compromise, giving you guided sleep help with a professional sleep specialist available via text messages.  I can’t say enough great things about my sleep counselor Shonda and all the help and guidance she provided and the tremendous Improvement in my sleep I have seen over the last 6 months.  It is expensive, but if you are as desperate for good sleep as I was, it is worth it!

reviews.title: They’ll just take your money
reviews.text: This company is has been charging me after I cancelled my subscription. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Not for everyone
reviews.text: I had no communication with a person after the 7 day trial.  Cancel after 6 days if it doesn’t help.  A lot of their advice is out there free.

reviews.title: Rip. Off
reviews.text: They offered a 7 day free trial, promising not to charge you and THEY did!!!

reviews.title: SCAM!
reviews.text:
they tell you it’s a free 7 day trial and they will notify you before they charge you. LIE. they tried to charge me right off the bat, but I had my credit card turned off. I turned my credit card on like a week later, and bam they got their charge in. clearly, I disputed it.
As for the app itself, it’s nothing but reading pre-generated material you can get for free on the Internet, it’s just advice and how to try to get more sleep. Using behavior therapy, it’s available for free on the Internet so basically you’re paying for nothing unless of course you just like to log on this app and log your sleep.

reviews.title: Danger - This is a scam
reviews.text:
Do not give these scammers your credit card information.  
I signed up for a two week trial. My card was charged but I did not receive login credentials. Customer service has not responded, but today I received an automated email stating that my card will be charged almost $300 in a few days with no way to opt out. 

I will have to contact my credit card company tomorrow for a charge back.

reviews.title: Helpful!
reviews.text:
This program gets results. Structured program that uses a combination of cognitive reframing and sleep restriction to get you back on track. First few weeks can be hard but you get access to a sleep coach who is helpful and knowledgeable and cheers you on. (Shonda was my coach - she was great !!). 

On the more expensive side but you can use an FSA which helps.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Sign up process silently till my money and refused to give me any content. I thought that maybe they just didn’t charge me/something went wrong on the backend and deleted the app. However I just received an email reminding me they’re renewing the subscription and the only way to cancel is through the app which refuses to believe I’m subscribed!

Really wish app developers were still forced to use Apple subscriptions where this nonsense never happens.

reviews.title: I can sleep
reviews.text: I definitely picked the right app to help me improve my sleep. Reset Sleep’s personalized plan, information/education and support have totally improved my sleep. I now sleep eight hours a night and I no longer deal with the frustration of long periods of sleeplessness through the night. I would strongly recommend Reset Sleep if you are dealing with issues with sleeplessness.

reviews.title: Improve your sleep!
reviews.text: This is a great program that can be covered by some insurances! Customer service was always very quick to respond to emails for questions and issues with the app. Mija was a very encouraging coach. My quality of sleep has improved dramatically and I didn’t realize the level of sleep anxiety I had before starting this program.

reviews.title: Sleeping much better today I
reviews.text: Sleep reset really helped me change my negative thoughts that were disrupting my sleep. The program used mild restriction and this markedly improved my sleep quality it deepened my sleep. Sleep hygiene advice you see everywhere did not help. I am grateful for the good listening and compassion of Shonda who guided me

reviews.title: Pricing wasn’t transparent
reviews.text: Got hit with huge bill (deductible) for nothing helpful

reviews.title: Beware! Deceptive billing practices!
reviews.text:
Enrolled after my doctor referred me. The app said my insurance was accepted, so I assumed I could get reimbursed. After paying ~$1,500, I was told I couldn’t get a Superbill because I never did a “required” consultation — something the app never prompted me to schedule.

Support admitted the app shouldn’t have shown my insurance as accepted, but only offered a $75 refund.

After posting online, I heard from many others with the same experience. This feels incredibly misleading.

reviews.title: Sleep improved in 4 weeks
reviews.text: This app has helped me with falling asleep faster, better sleep hygiene, and waking up in the morning in just 4 weeks. Although it is expensive I’m definitely going to continue because it has worked for me and I want to continue to improve and create long term sleep hygiene.

reviews.title: It truly works
reviews.text: I started to suffer with insomnia persistently back in November ‘25 and it continued to get worse until I started the sleep reset program. Mija has been my sleep coach throughout my journey and between her, the lessons, the sleep schedule & the meds, it truly did work. 4 months later and I’m medicine-free, getting 8 hours of sleep a night. Truly feels like a miracle.

reviews.title: Good Science/Poor Technology
reviews.text: The science that the app uses is excellent. Unfortunately, the app itself is not well thought out and has numerous glitches. Throughout my 5 or so weeks with the program, I constantly had to be in touch with customer service regarding various technology issues. Very frustrating. Personal coaching is very good. But overall, not worth the money until they figure out the technology/interface.

reviews.title: App does not upload info or remember results!
reviews.text:
I was so excited to use this app, as it was recommended by a podcaster, Forrest Hanson from the “being well” podcast.

I filled out all the information, spent the time for their “personalized survey”
Then followed the prompts to upload my insurance information, the app doesn’t allow you to upload as it wants you to and then info just disappeared. A Colossal waste of time.

reviews.title: Confusing Pricing and Disappointing Support
reviews.text: I signed up believing Sleep Reset cost about $20 per month. After the one-week trial, I was charged $249 for an annual subscription. I contacted support right away to explain the misunderstanding and request a refund, but they refused. What bothered me most was that the reasoning changed. First the answer was that refunds were not allowed. Later, I was told a refund could not be issued because of “system limitations.” Those are not the same thing, and the inconsistency made the response feel evasive. I also asked where I could leave public feedback and was directed only to reply privately by email. Overall, it was a disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Really works!
reviews.text: I’ve been telling everyone about this app. If you are struggling with insomnia, this program truly works. I learned so much, and am on the path to better sleep. You get an excellent support system with a human coach, nurse clinician and daily lessons and tracking. I’m in a totally different place because of it!

reviews.title: Couldn’t even get into the app…
reviews.text: Downloaded the app and it would not let me go past the Home Screen. Honestly can’t even tell you if it works or not. I kept clicking take test and nothing. 🤷🏻‍♀️ oh well, I’ll try an app that actually works for me.

reviews.title: not alone in this trip
reviews.text: i feel supported by my coach she answers my questions and addresses my battles in this hard time in my life with sleep and my worries about it

reviews.title: Had great suppprt
reviews.text: I enrolled in Sleep Reset after struggling with insomnia that persisted.  Rebecca, Sleep Medicine Nurse, and Shonda, Sleep Coach were the best.  They were kind, warm and compassionate.  They supported me and reminded me that I could get through.  I already had most of the tools.  Together they helped remind me of that.  Thank you!

reviews.title: Can address life long sleep problems
reviews.text: This is program is well worth your time and energy. It will be hard, but the overall toll will that poor sleep takes on health more than makes it worthwhile.

reviews.title: Good idea but disappointing
reviews.text: I was hopeful after my appointment with the doctor. What I found since is the app is very glitchy. The calculations don’t add up and recently it won’t even update with a new schedule. The coach is  pretty much useless. They’re Respond intermittently with general information. ChatGPT is more helpful than the coach is

reviews.title: Feedback on the app
reviews.text: This app is just to make money but, nothing. The ask you to log but, don’t provide any inputs based on log, the coaches assigned are just spectators, no follow-ups, no advises. The advises you get on app are like any insta messages, very generic and not specific to your problem, don’t fell into the trap.. I paid ~280$ per month for this scrap.. waste of money..

reviews.title: Excellent Insomnia help
reviews.text: The program provides a way to track my sleep, ways to better understand sleep habits and aids on how to change unhelpful. The coach responds in a timely manner and it is easy to connect with the technician every couple weeks. There also guided meditations that make it easier to fall asleep in a timely manner.

reviews.title: Lesson/coach
reviews.text: I like the fact that there is a coach that actually responds to your messages and I like the lessons, learning a lot about sleep.

reviews.title: Pricey but so worth it!
reviews.text: Before using Sleep Reset I had insomnia basically every night for 3 years. I would get up at 3-4am and then take 2 Benadryl and Tylenol to get back to sleep.  I paid $594 to do the program in May and June of last year, $297 for each month.  The price is steep, but well worth it.  It worked for me!  I found the sleep compression to be tolerable and helpful.  I was consistent and did my lessons and sleep log every day.  I appreciated the accountability that the app provides.  Mija was helpful with answering my questions.  I found the breathing exercises extremely helpful.  I still use them to this day.  After the program I didn’t need Benadryl any more and was getting some of the best sleep in years. Thank God!  And thank you, Sleep Reset!  However, I do have to say you need to stay consistent with what the program teaches in order to have lasting results.  I’ve found myself slipping into some old habits and have used Benadryl from time to time to get back to sleep.  I could see people wanting to go through the program again to get back on track.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and registered and they said that I would need to have an appointment with one of their doctors before we can start and I had to give my insurance information. Soonest appointment they had was a week out. I waited the week, and 10 minutes before my appointment I got an email saying that they canceled my appointment. No reason why just they canceled it. So I tried, but apparently they do not want my business. I’ll find another option.

reviews.title: Excellent Sleep Program AND Customer Service!
reviews.text:
Let me tell you, I don’t usually do reviews, and this sleep program and my sleep coach have been excellent. 

The interface is clean, it includes a sleep coach, and it gave me a technique which helps quite well with my thoughts! I have eliminated practices which were not serving before, and were given sleep tips which made me be able to sleep faster, and learned mistakes which were costing my sleep before. My late night awakenings were also much less frequent than before, and I would say my dwellings on “I need to fall asleep right now!” dwindled.  So my mindset for sleep had changed a bit! 

Let me also mention the customer service: a shout out to the customer service team! The customer support was so polite and professional. They helped set up my account, answered questions quickly, and really seemed to want to help the user. 

I have learned a lot from this program and appreciate this! Here is my only note for those coming across this program: 

One, if you have preexisting conditions which could affect your sleep, talk to a health professional first, if possible, before pursuing the program. I would have loved to continue, but unfortunately, due to preexisting conditions,  the restriction technique was probably more brutal than it normally would have been, affecting my ability to follow the sleep principles and techniques well, among other things. In my opinion as well, I would say, if you have preexisting conditions that could potentially affect your ability to follow the program, to potential ensure you can get a sleep coach as well. There is a self guided option, but I realize that it may be a bumpy road for myself, someone who has preexisting conditions, which may make my path to doing the program a bit more unique. 

Overall, I would say this app is great! I am just personally doing it at the wrong time. I hope to participate in the program much more fully in the future, because does subtly impact things beyond sleep; it gives you tools for changing your mindset.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service and free trial is scam
reviews.text: I got the free trial and was charged $20. I canceled it before my trial ended. I emailed them and sent a message to the chat in the app and was told someone would respond, but nobody ever did. Terrible customer service!

reviews.title: Don’t count on the coaches
reviews.text: This is a great teaching and accountability app to keep a consistent schedule, but don’t count on the coaches to help you tailor the program to meet your individual needs!

reviews.title: It’s a trap - $279 and more for sleep health
reviews.text: They don’t reveal it until AFTER you’ve given them all you info and answered everything. They’re hoping you’ll invest after that. They have a week free trial but I’m sure they’re banking on people not remembering or being desperate enough that they pay. We are in a recession right now and poor people geenerally have more stress when it comes to sleep. This is absolutely greedy and awful. Really feels not good.  I got tricked into giving my email  because i reasonably figured their price wouldn’t be insane

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: I’ve done this program twice in the past 4 years. First, when I had insomnia so bad I went into psychosis, and then 2 years later when life changes and extreme anxiety made it very hard for me to fall asleep. It has helped more than any sleeping pill ever could, it gets to the root causes and teaches you the science of sleep— while also having the support, encouragement, and knowledge from your sleep coach (thank you to Mija!) I went from pure insomnia with racing thoughts and panic attacks to being able fall asleep within minutes. I never take time to write reviews but this app is truly a game changer, so much so that I returned to it when I needed a refresher. Yes, it was expensive, but even as a broke girl I would say this is incredibly worth it. It will change your relationship with your body, mind, and environment around sleep.

reviews.title: Love the guidance
reviews.text: Appreciate the daily constructive tips on improving sleep- this has helped me a lot, especially with just getting out of bed and doing something relaxing in the middle of the night if my mind is alert or stressed and I’m leaning towards that tossing and turning stage. Some coaches are more responsive and ask better questions than others.. can switch coaches if yours isn’t that engaged.

reviews.title: Very effective program for addressing insomnia issues
reviews.text: I’ve been using Sleep Reset for about a month, and my sleep has definitely improved. The app has strategies and tools for setting a wind down routine and managing wake ups in the middle of the night. And the meetings with a nurse practitioner and messaging with a sleep coach are very helpful. You’re not on your own with an app. The initial period is rough with any CBT program, but you’re given strategies for dealing with fatigue and getting over the hump. The short daily lessons are very useful in making the simple lifestyle changes needed to get better sleep.

reviews.title: Best decision I ever made
reviews.text: Signing up with Sleep Reset was great.  They gave me the skills, and the confidence to work toward a better night’s sleep. My coach Mija was always there when I needed her.

reviews.title: Evidence based sleep program
reviews.text: I love this, I used to recommend Cleveland Clinic Go to Sleep, but now that program is discontinued so I will recommend this to my patients.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: What a great program! The daily lessons were informative and quick. I learned so much about sleep. My coach, Mija, was wonderful. She was my biggest cheerleader and always there for questions. I am sleeping better without medicine and have skills to use daily help me maintain my progress. I highly recommend giving this program a try. You are not alone in this journey and they remind you of that fact often which is comforting.

reviews.title: Slept
reviews.text: Slept

reviews.title: See a doctor
reviews.text: While most treatment for any type of insomnia will probably result in CBT, this app is not a replacement for getting a proper diagnosis and is no replacement for seeing a doctor.

reviews.title: Apple Pay Does not work
reviews.text: After the Epic games ruling and the ability for application developers to offer things other than Apple’s payment system, developers are missing out on revenue even if they have to pay some kind of commission to Apple. I don’t want to manage subscriptions for every little app that’s on my phone. Tried to use Apple Pay with Sleep Reset and it didn’t work. I’m not going to give my credit card information and have some Subscription renewal happen automatically and have no way to track it. I’m sure it will end up like trying to cancel your cable subscription. Apple made subs and in-app purchases elegant and simple, developers who choose this new system are making it cumbersome and stupid.
